paper_title: RADES axion search results with a High-Temperature Superconducting cavity in an 11.7 T magnet
notes: RADES haloscope search with HTS (ReBCO) coated cavity in 11.7 T dipole magnet at CERN SM18. 27 h of data at ~8.84 GHz. Exclusion limit set over narrow mass range 36.5676-36.5699 ueV (554 kHz width) at 95% CL, spanning g_agamma from 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (least sensitive, low-mass edge where fewer data recorded) to 1.59e-13 GeV^-1 (best). Only the two boundary values are given in text; the detailed limit shape (shown in Fig. 9 inset) is not tabulated, so the two emitted points bracket the excluded band rather than trace the exact curve. Standard isothermal halo model assumed with rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
